text:
Noah Li: Noticing a pattern: p99 spikes for /v1/embeddings in the dashboard that don't correspond to p95/p50. spikes line up with minutes that have <10 samples.
Tara Gomez: sounds like a small-n tdigest artifact. Are we computing p99 from merged tdigests or by merging per-route percentiles?
Noah Li: console query shows merged tdigests across routes before percentile calc.
Ravi Shah: that's the problem. Merging lossy summaries from tiny groups produces noisy tails. We should surface a fidelity signal in the UI.
Mina Park: UX idea: hide p99 in the default line chart and add a secondary heatmap (samples/min) below. p99 can be toggled on; when toggled we show a confidence pill (green/amber/red) based on samples and route-consistency.
ConsoleUI: backend options: 1) add 2 numeric rollup fields (samples_total, routes_entropy) and keep string-free schema changes; 2) compute both merged-raw and per-route-merged on-demand (higher query cost); 3) keep as-is and document caveat.
Tara Gomez: prefer 1. small storage cost but cheap for UI to compute confidence locally. routes_entropy = how spread samples are across routes (Shannon) — high entropy means many tiny buckets.
Ravi Shah: also record tdigest_bucket_count or compression_depth so we can flag low-fidelity tdigest merges.
Mina Park: front-end will render: p50/p95 lines, a collapsed p99 chip with confidence color, and an expandable per-minute pane that shows per-route p99s + sample counts. default: hide p99 for sample_total < 50.
Noah Li: that default will cut a lot of noise. product teams can opt-in.
ConsoleUI: infra-bot scheduled: rollup-schema#209 will add samples_total and routes_entropy to 2024-06-20 staging. Console flag PR queued.
infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: rollup-schema#209 -> staging at 2024-06-20T09:00Z.
Mina Park: I'll mock the UI change and put screenshots in the PR. Also add a tooltip: "p99 may be unreliable when sample count is low or traffic is highly fragmented across route variants."
Ravi Shah: follow-up: we should log a short trace when console requests merged-p99 and sample_total < threshold so we can audit any false alerts.
Tara Gomez: created issue eng-platform#554 to add trace and telemetry.
Noah Li: thanks all — this should reduce false positives in the latency-runbook. :thumbsup:
